summary: Phase 1 testing complete. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed (root, auth, capacity, unlock, slot CRUD, create-limit 403, export, import insufficient/force/sentence-kind/invalid-kind). Frontend: Full anonymous flow and authenticated flow validated end-to-end via Playwright with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Login page renders with google-login-btn and anonymous-login-btn. Anonymous login lands on /dashboard with all 10 slot cards (slots 1-3 createable, 4-10 locked). NameSlotModal creates slots in localStorage. Tab switch between word/sentence keeps slots independent. Ad simulation modal (5s mock) unlocks slot 4 successfully. SlotEditor /slot/:id supports item add/delete with correct data-testids. Authenticated session via injected session_token cookie shows user-nickname, logout-btn works, export triggers JSON download (cnxue_word_*.json), import of 5 slots opens InsufficientSlotsModal showing missing=2/available=3/incoming=5, and insuff-force-import imports 3 and skips 2 with Korean success toast.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to NameSlotModal and InsufficientSlotsModal for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to Radix Dialog instances to silence a11y warnings (NameSlotModal, InsufficientSlotsModal, AdSimulationModal).
(Optional) Backend /api/slots/import does not validate slot dict shape beyond .get(); malformed items would still import. Consider Pydantic validation on incoming slot items for robustness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) consistently and stores tz-aware datetimes in Mongo. Good.
Export endpoint correctly strips user_id / slot_id / internal fields before returning - verified by test_export_slots.
create_session uses upsert for sessions and returns full user doc with _id stripped - good.
Import endpoint correctly handles partial-import via free_indices computed from existing slot_indices and capacity.total_capacity, ensuring premium slots are skipped when locked.
Pydantic Slot model uses Field(default_factory=...) for slot_id/timestamps so new slots get unique IDs - good.
Frontend store.js auto-routes between API and localStorage based on auth state; isolation between word/sentence kinds verified.
test_credentials: No app-managed credentials. Auth tested by inserting test user+session in MongoDB (test_database) per /app/auth_testing.md; cleanup done after run.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates an isolated TEST_user_<uuid> user + session and cleans up via pytest fixture teardown. Final cleanup script run to remove any remaining TEST_ prefixed docs from users/user_sessions/slots/slot_unlocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and rely on direct MongoDB user/session insertion via pymongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from env). Frontend e2e uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://vocab-slots.preview.emergentagent.com). For auth-gated frontend tests, inject cookie {name: session_token, domain: vocab-slots.preview.emergentagent.com, secure: True, sameSite: None} after seeding user+session in Mongo. AdSimulationModal mock requires ~6s wait after ad-start-btn before ad-claim-btn is enabled. Phase 2 features (quiz/flash/bookmark/game) are intentionally 'soon' placeholders - do not flag.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found in Phase 1 scope.
